messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx (gateway timeout) from hosted-us-west1. error-rate 5xx = 18% over last 5m; SLO risk. paging maya (on-call).

maya: on it. pulling graphs. which customers impacted / any region correlation?

oncall-bot: affected routes: /v1/generate and /v1/stream. traffic concentrated in us-west1 (70%). some retries showing provider-level timeouts.

maya: ok — starting triage. @raj can you check cloud provider metrics / network flaps? tagging @eli for model-serving health.

raj: looking at provider console now — GCP us-west1 has elevated network retransmits to a subset of egress gateways since ~10:02UTC. A couple of instance groups showing 30-40% p99 latency spikes.

eli: model runtime pools in us-west1 show many inflight requests stuck in send phase; node-level logs show tcp resets from 10:00 onward. CPU/mem fine.

maya: sounds like provider-network -> we should do live mitigations to avoid customer impact. Recommendations: 1) partial brownout for non-paid tiers (disable streaming + lower token cap), 2) drain traffic from us-west1 to eu-west1 + enable provider reroute, 3) emergency rate-limit for anonymous/free keys. Thoughts?

raj: agree. draining is safest long-term but take care with latency bump for EU. suggest progressive drain: 50% -> 80% -> 100% over 10m windows and watch errors. I can trigger route change via ork-routing API.

maya: eli, can we tolerate moving active KV caches? any model state we need to preserve?

eli: KV caches are per-region; new requests from eu-west1 will warm up cache. recommend we prioritize critical customers to dedicated clusters so they keep stable. non-critical can accept cold-start.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: "Network-caused 5xx in region" — checklist: 1) page cloud-sre, 2) throttle non-prod + free tier, 3) start drain command, 4) open provider ticket, 5) update status page.

maya: I'll do throttle + status. @support-bot can you post an advisory for customers on impacted region and guidance for retries/backoff?

support-bot: posting incident advisory to status.redwood.ai — message drafted. Will include guidance to set Retry-After and reduce concurrency.

maya: executing emergency rate-limit for free tier now to reduce pressure: internal command ->
```
POST /admin/quotas/mod
{
  "scope": "free-tier",
  "action": "set_rate_limit",
  "requests_per_minute": 60
}
```

oncall-bot: Rate-limit change applied to free-tier (edge cache). Effective in ~30s.

raj: starting progressive drain from us-west1 -> eu-west1. Command:
```
PATCH /admin/routing
{
  "region": "us-west1",
  "drain_percent": 50,
  "target_region": "eu-west1",
  "window_minutes": 10
}
```

raj: applied 50% drain at 10:12UTC. monitoring.

maya: enabling partial brownout: disable streaming responses for free-tier and lower max tokens for free orgs to 256.

eli: brownout applied. streaming disabled for free-tier, token cap enforced. Expect fewer long-lived connections.

cloud-sre: opened ticket with provider (GCP) 123456789 — they acknowledge network anomalies in subset of egress gateways. They recommend failover if possible.

maya: good. observations after 50% drain: 5xx down from 18% -> 9% in 3m. latency p95 increased slightly for eu users but within tolerable.

raj: proceeding to 80% drain. Applying:
```
PATCH /admin/routing
{
  "region": "us-west1",
  "drain_percent": 80,
  "target_region": "eu-west1",
  "window_minutes": 5
}
```

ops-runbook-bot: Reminder: update on-call rotation if handoff needed.

zoe-pm: tagging here to let product know potential degradation for EU customer trials — will notify large customers w/ account leads.

maya: 80% drain done at 10:20UTC. 5xx now 4%. initiating provider reroute for remaining 20% to multi-cloud fallback (aws-us-west-2).

raj: routing change: BGP/proxy rules updated to prefer aws-us-west-2 for remaining fraction. Executed.

eli: model backs look healthy on aws/us-west-2 and eu-west1. KV cold-warm happening but within expected.

support-bot: customer messages queued: major customers X & Y informed via email; public status updated: "Degradation in us-west1 — traffic failing over; mitigations in progress."

maya: monitoring dashboard — overall 5xx now under 1.5% global. good. progressively move to 100% drain?

raj: yes. moving remaining 20% -> drain 100% now.

raj: applied drain 100% at 10:28UTC. us-west1 now receives only background maintenance traffic.

cloud-sre: provider notified to take affected egress nodes out of rotation.

maya: verifying failover health — run quick smoke:
```
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" | jq .
# expect {"ok": true, "region": "eu-west1"}
```

eli: smoke passes for eu-west1 & aws-us-west-2.

maya: handing off to @raj for overnight monitoring and follow-up RCA. I'm off shift in 20m — leave notes in incident doc.

raj: taking over. will keep 15m poll on error-rate and update every 30m. initiating post-incident customer-impact assessment.

ops-runbook-bot: Template: impact_assessment.md (add: affected routes, percent traffic rerouted, mitigation actions, customer list, ETA for recovery).

raj: filling in quick numbers: affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/stream. peak affected customers ~3% of active orgs, mostly free tier and a handful of EU trial customers. revenue-critical customers on Dedicated were routed to dedicated clusters and unaffected.

zoe-pm: thanks — we'll prep comms for the trial customers and include mitigation steps / timeline.

support-bot: monitoring support queue, prioritizing tickets from orgs with production labels.

maya: quick note for postmortem: consider adding automated region-autoswitch policy on provider-network flaps and pre-warmed cache strategy for cross-region failover.

raj: noted. scheduling RCA meeting 48h from now with cloud-sre + runtime + oncall.

cloud-sre: provider confirmed partial outage resolution at 11:15UTC and will share RCA. leaving nodes out of rotation until tomorrow morning.

raj: beginning controlled re-injection to us-west1 at 11:40UTC at 5% -> monitor 15m.

maya: thanks team. closing channel for now — will reopen if any regressions. Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.

ops-runbook-bot: Incident state changed to MITIGATED by maya. Incident doc: https://internal.redwood/incident/1750001234

raj: final note: mitigation actions taken: emergency rate-limit (free-tier), partial brownout (disable streaming free-tier), progressive drain -> full failover to eu-west1 + aws-us-west-2, provider ticket opened. Postmortem will include follow-up actions and timeline.

eli: confirming metrics stable. marking incident as resolved in my workflow pending RCA.

support-bot: status page updated to RESOLVED at 12:05UTC.

maya: good job everyone. :thumbsup:
